description: This file defines a custom attribute and related classes for xUnit testing framework to facilitate skipping database-dependent tests when the database environment is unavailable. It includes logic to evaluate database availability based on environment variables and Docker presence, and provides custom attributes and discoverers to implement this skipping behavior during test discovery.

classes.name: RequiresDatabaseAttribute
classes.description: An attribute to mark test classes or methods as requiring a database, with evaluation logic for database availability based on environment variables and Docker presence.

classes.name: RequiresDatabaseAttribute.DbTestDatabaseAvailability
classes.description: Record encapsulating the availability status and reason for database accessibility.

classes.name: DbFactAttribute
classes.description: Custom xUnit fact attribute that skips tests if the database isn't available.

classes.name: DbTheoryAttribute
classes.description: Custom xUnit theory attribute that skips tests if the database isn't available.

classes.name: DbFactDiscoverer
classes.description: Discoverer for DbFactAttribute that applies skip logic during test discovery.

classes.name: DbTheoryDiscoverer
classes.description: Discoverer for DbTheoryAttribute that applies skip logic during test discovery.

methods.name: EvaluateAvailability
methods.description: Evaluates database availability based on environment variables and Docker presence.

methods.name: NormalizeEnv
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable string values by trimming whitespace and quotes.

methods.name: IsDockerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if Docker is available by running 'docker version --format ...' and inspecting the process exit code.
